topics.concept: The ReAct loop interleaves reasoning with acting: the agent writes a thought, picks a tool action, reads the observation, and repeats until the task is done. This thought-action-observation cycle lets the agent recover from tool errors instead of failing on the first try. A step budget and stop conditions prevent infinite loops.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded multi-step tasks with mock tools and counts steps to completion and recovery rate after tool errors.
topics.name: ReAct Agent Loop
topics.real_world_use: Research and support agents that must gather information before answering use this loop.

topics.concept: A tool-using agent extends the model with callable functions such as calculators, search, and database lookups described in a tool schema. The agent selects tools by matching the task to tool descriptions and formats arguments as structured data. Argument validation catches malformed calls before execution.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded tasks requiring specific tools and measures correct tool selection and argument accuracy.
topics.name: Tool-Using Agent
topics.real_world_use: Assistants that check calendars, compute totals, or query databases rely on tool calls.

topics.concept: A tool registry is the catalog every agent consults: each tool has a name, description, parameter schema, and permission level. Good descriptions are the difference between an agent picking the right tool and guessing. The registry also enforces access control so agents cannot call privileged tools.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded tool catalogs with permission tiers and tests selection accuracy and permission denials.
topics.name: Agent Tool Registry
topics.real_world_use: Enterprise agent platforms manage hundreds of tools with governed access.

topics.concept: A function-calling router maps model outputs to concrete function invocations by parsing the structured call the model emits. The router validates arguments, dispatches to the implementation, and feeds results back for the next reasoning step. Parallel call support lets independent functions run in one turn.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded model outputs with valid and invalid calls and measures dispatch success and error handling.
topics.name: Function Calling Router
topics.real_world_use: Voice assistants and chatbots execute user requests through structured function calls.

topics.concept: A sequential agent pipeline chains specialist agents so the output of one becomes the input of the next: researcher to writer to editor. Each stage has a clear contract, which makes failures easy to localize. The simulation tracks how errors compound across stages versus get corrected.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded pipeline tasks and measures end-to-end quality versus single-agent baselines.
topics.name: Sequential Agent Pipeline
topics.real_world_use: Content production workflows chain drafting, fact-checking, and editing agents.

topics.concept: Agent memory stores conversation history, user preferences, and task state across turns so the agent does not start from zero each time. Short-term working memory holds the current task while long-term memory persists facts across sessions. Summarization keeps memory bounded as conversations grow.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded multi-session conversations and checks that recalled facts match stored ones.
topics.name: Agent Memory Store
topics.real_world_use: Personal assistants remember preferences and ongoing projects between sessions.

topics.concept: Plan-and-execute agents first write an explicit step-by-step plan, then work through it, revising the plan when steps fail or reveal new information. Separating planning from execution makes the strategy inspectable and lets a human approve the plan up front. Replanning triggers on failed steps or surprising observations.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded tasks with hidden obstacles and measures plan success and replanning frequency.
topics.name: Plan-and-Execute Agent
topics.real_world_use: Complex request handlers in operations tools plan multi-step fixes before acting.

topics.concept: A research agent plans a set of queries, gathers evidence from simulated sources, and synthesizes findings with citations. Query reformulation handles poor initial results by broadening or narrowing the search. The final report separates confirmed facts from uncertain claims.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded source documents with planted facts and checks citation accuracy in reports.
topics.name: Web Research Agent Sim
topics.real_world_use: Market research and due-diligence tools compile cited briefings automatically.

topics.concept: A data analysis agent takes a dataset and a question, then writes and runs analysis code in a sandbox, iterating on errors. It reports findings with the exact steps taken so results are reproducible. Guardrails restrict it to read-only operations on a copy of the data.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded datasets with known patterns and checks the agent recovers them with correct code.
topics.name: Data Analysis Agent
topics.real_world_use: Analytics copilots explore data and draft charts on natural-language request.

topics.concept: An email triage agent classifies incoming messages by urgency and topic, drafts replies for routine ones, and flags the rest for a human. Priority scoring weighs sender importance, deadlines, and action verbs in the body. The simulation tracks how many urgent emails get delayed by misclassification.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded inboxes with labeled urgency and measures triage accuracy and draft acceptance rate.
topics.name: Email Triage Agent
topics.real_world_use: Executive assistants pre-sort inboxes so urgent mail never waits.

topics.concept: Multi-agent orchestration coordinates several agents toward one goal, with a conductor assigning subtasks and merging results. Orchestration patterns include fan-out for parallel work and debate for contested decisions. The simulation measures coordination overhead against the speedup from parallelism.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded decomposable tasks and compares orchestrated versus single-agent completion time and quality.
topics.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
topics.real_world_use: Complex analysis pipelines split research, synthesis, and review across agents.

topics.concept: A self-reflecting agent critiques its own draft answer against a checklist, then revises before responding. Reflection catches missing constraints, weak reasoning, and tone problems that a single pass misses. The simulation compares single-pass versus reflect-and-revise quality on a scored rubric.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded tasks with known rubrics and measures quality gain from reflection passes.
topics.name: Self-Reflecting Agent
topics.real_world_use: Writing and coding assistants improve drafts through internal critique loops.

topics.concept: Sub-agent delegation lets a main agent spawn focused helpers for subtasks and collect their results, keeping the main context window clean. Each sub-agent gets a narrow brief and returns a summary, which the parent integrates. Depth limits prevent runaway delegation trees.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded hierarchical tasks and measures context savings versus flat single-agent runs.
topics.name: Sub-Agent Delegation
topics.real_world_use: Deep research tools delegate topic slices to parallel sub-agents.

topics.concept: Parallel fanout dispatches independent subtasks to multiple agents at once and gathers the results when all finish. Timeout and partial-failure policies decide what happens when one worker stalls. The simulation shows near-linear speedup when subtasks are truly independent.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded parallelizable workloads with injected worker delays and measures speedup and timeout handling.
topics.name: Parallel Agent Fanout
topics.real_world_use: Bulk document processing and multi-source research run in parallel for speed.

topics.concept: Supervisor-worker teams put one coordinator in charge of task breakdown, assignment, and quality review while workers execute. The supervisor reassigns failed subtasks and resolves conflicting worker outputs. This hierarchy scales better than flat peer teams for large task graphs.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded task graphs with worker failures and measures completion rate under supervision.
topics.name: Supervisor-Worker Teams
topics.real_world_use: Operations automation uses supervisors to coordinate fleets of task agents.

topics.concept: Agent guardrails are runtime checks that constrain what an agent may do: allowed tools, spending caps, forbidden topics, and required human approvals. The guardrail layer inspects every planned action and blocks or escalates violations before execution. Audit logs record every blocked attempt for review.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded tasks with planted policy violations and measures block rate and false-positive escalations.
topics.name: Agent Guardrails
topics.real_world_use: Regulated industries wrap agents in policy checks before deployment.

topics.concept: Critic debate pits two agents against each other: one proposes a solution and the other attacks it, with a judge picking the winner after several rounds. Adversarial critique surfaces flaws that a single agent rationalizes away. The simulation scores final answers against a ground-truth rubric.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded problems with hidden flaws in naive solutions and measures debate versus solo accuracy.
topics.name: Critic Debate Agents
topics.real_world_use: High-stakes decision tools stress-test proposals through structured adversarial review.

topics.concept: A customer support agent greets users, diagnoses issues through clarifying questions, and follows runbooks for known problems. Escalation rules hand off to humans when confidence drops or the issue matches a sensitive category. Conversation quality is scored on resolution rate and politeness.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded support scenarios with runbooks and measures resolution and escalation accuracy.
topics.name: Customer Support Agent Sim
topics.real_world_use: Support chatbots resolve common issues and escalate the rest with context.

topics.concept: A report-writing agent gathers data from simulated sources, drafts sections against an outline, and revises for consistency and tone. Section-level parallelism speeds up long reports while a final pass unifies terminology. Word-count and citation requirements are enforced per section.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded source datasets and checks reports for outline coverage and citation presence.
topics.name: Report Writing Agent
topics.real_world_use: Consulting and analytics tools draft data-backed reports from raw inputs.

topics.concept: A trivia host agent runs a full game: asking questions, tracking scores, giving hints on request, and declaring a winner. Difficulty adapts to player performance so games stay competitive. The simulation plays seeded games with synthetic players of varying skill.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded question banks and simulated players, then checks scoring and adaptive difficulty behavior.
topics.name: Trivia Game Host Agent
topics.real_world_use: Entertainment bots host interactive quiz games in chat apps.

topics.concept: A scheduling agent negotiates meeting times across attendees by reading calendars, proposing slots, and handling conflicts. Preference rules encode working hours, focus-time protection, and buffer between meetings. The simulation measures how many rounds of negotiation typical requests need.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded calendars with conflicts and measures scheduled success rate and negotiation rounds.
topics.name: Scheduling Agent Sim
topics.real_world_use: Executive assistant tools coordinate meetings across busy calendars.

topics.concept: A shopping comparison agent collects product options against user criteria, normalizes specs into a comparison table, and recommends the best value. It explains trade-offs instead of just naming a winner. Price-change monitoring flags when a recommendation goes stale.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded product catalogs with hidden best values and checks recommendation accuracy.
topics.name: Shopping Comparison Agent
topics.real_world_use: Buying guides and deal-finder bots compare options across retailers.

topics.concept: A trip-planning agent turns constraints like budget, dates, and interests into a day-by-day itinerary with bookings and backups. It balances travel time against activity density and flags infeasible legs. Constraint relaxation proposes trade-offs when no plan fits the budget.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded destinations with costs and checks itineraries for budget and feasibility.
topics.name: Trip Planning Agent Sim
topics.real_world_use: Travel assistants build personalized itineraries from natural-language requests.

topics.concept: A code-fixing agent reproduces a reported bug in a sandbox, proposes a patch, runs the test suite, and iterates until tests pass. Regression checks make sure the fix does not break unrelated tests. The simulation plants known bugs and measures fix rate within the attempt budget.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded buggy functions with test suites and measures repair success rate.

key_params.regression_check: run full suite or targeted tests

topics.name: Code Fixing Agent
topics.real_world_use: Developer tools auto-fix failing tests and lint errors in CI.

topics.concept: A code review team splits review duties: one agent checks correctness, another security, a third style, and a lead merges findings into a single review. Specialization catches issues a generalist reviewer misses. Severity ranking orders findings so authors fix the important ones first.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded diffs with planted issues per specialty and measures coverage per reviewer.
topics.name: Code Review Agent Team
topics.real_world_use: Engineering teams run multi-angle automated reviews on pull requests.

topics.concept: An incident response agent follows a runbook: acknowledge the alert, gather diagnostics, hypothesize the cause, and propose or apply mitigations. Escalation paths trigger when the blast radius grows or the runbook is exhausted. Post-incident, it drafts a timeline for the review.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded incidents with known root causes and measures time-to-mitigation.

key_params.auto_mitigate: whether to apply fixes without approval

topics.name: Incident Response Agent Sim
topics.real_world_use: SRE teams use agents for first-response triage during outages.

topics.concept: A document review agent checks contracts and policies against a checklist of required clauses and risky language. Each finding cites the exact passage and suggests replacement wording. Review coverage reporting shows which checklist items were addressed.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded documents with planted missing clauses and risky terms, then measures finding recall.
topics.name: Document Review Agent
topics.real_world_use: Legal and compliance teams pre-screen agreements before human review.

topics.concept: A budget planning agent allocates a budget across categories from goals and constraints, then defends the allocation with a written rationale. Scenario analysis shows what changes if income drops or a priority shifts. Variance tracking compares planned versus simulated actual spending.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded income and expense profiles and checks allocation feasibility and rationale completeness.
topics.name: Budget Planning Agent Sim
topics.real_world_use: Finance tools draft department budgets and model trade-offs.

topics.concept: A brainstorming team generates ideas divergently, then clusters them, critiques weaknesses, and converges on the strongest few. Role prompts like optimist and skeptic keep the critique honest. The simulation scores final ideas on novelty and feasibility against a seeded rubric.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded problem briefs and measures idea diversity and convergence quality.
topics.name: Brainstorming Agent Team
topics.real_world_use: Innovation workshops use agent teams to expand and refine idea pools.

topics.concept: A negotiation agent bargains over price or terms against a simulated counterpart with its own hidden reservation price. Strategy parameters control opening offers, concession rate, and walk-away points. The simulation measures deal rate and surplus captured across strategy profiles.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded negotiations with known reservation prices and reports outcomes per strategy.
topics.name: Negotiation Game Agent
topics.real_world_use: Procurement tools practice and automate routine price negotiations.
